stem: Which statement best expresses the main conflict in the excerpt?

options.label: F
options.text: Lola is upset that her best friend Ella has come to her house so early in the morning.

options.label: G
options.text: Carla Santini, the most popular girl in school, wants the lead role in the school play.

options.label: H
options.text: Ella respects Lola and wants her to talk to Carla Santini and her classmates.

options.label: J
options.text: Lola tries to avoid performing in a play because of the negative reaction she has received at school.
